name: @hobo/backend-routing
description: HoBo cost-based choosing for one-active fleets: billing periods and usage units, and the budget policies that keep, switch or fail over a database fleet (decideFleet) and route a loss-tolerant fleet by free, prepaid and pay-as-you-go preference with hysteresis (routeFleetByBudget). The assignment register and member health live in @hobo/fleet.
